new_candidates.body:
Follow-up to #193. The detailed report is available in the Alpamayo repository: [Alpamayo #40](https://github.com/NVlabs/alpamayo1.5/issues/40).

It documents an avoidable stationary-lead collision trajectory with Alpamayo 1.5 in native AlpaSim, including reproduction instructions, logs, and videos.

A related stationary-lead collision was also observed with Alpamayo 2 Super in a CARLA test ([Alpamayo #39](https://github.com/NVlabs/alpamayo1.5/issues/39)).
new_candidates.title: [Follow-up to #193] Stationary-lead collision report for Alpamayo 1.5 and 2 Super
